# LearnHouse Documentation

> LearnHouse is an open-source learning platform: a block editor for courses, AI tutoring, assignments, payments and communities, on LearnHouse Cloud or self-hosted with one command. Developers can build on it with the REST API, the @learnhouse/sdk TypeScript client, and the @learnhouse/react and @learnhouse/vue components.

Every page below is plain Markdown at its URL. The complete text of all pages is at https://docs.learnhouse.app/llms-full.txt.

## Get started

- [Introduction](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started.md): What LearnHouse is, how it is organized, and the fastest way to start — on LearnHouse Cloud or on your own servers.
- [Cloud vs Self Hosting](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started/cloud-vs-self-hosting.md)
- [Key Concepts](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started/key-concepts.md)
- [Quickstart](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started/quickstart.md)
- [Guides](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides.md): Hands-on, end-to-end guides for building with LearnHouse. Ship your own headless learning platform with Next.js, drive the API, and react to events with webhooks.
- [Build a Learning Platform](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform.md): Build your own headless learning platform on the web with Next.js and the LearnHouse API. Start with an anonymous public catalogue, then add authentication, enrollment, and progress tracking.
- [Agent Spec](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform/agent-spec.md): A self-contained, copy-paste specification a coding agent can follow to build a headless LearnHouse learning platform with Next.js, including the exact API contract and acceptance criteria.
- [Build It Yourself](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform/do-it-yourself.md): A complete, tested, step-by-step guide to building a headless learning platform with Next.js and the LearnHouse API. Public catalogue first, then authentication, enrollment, and progress tracking.
- [Let an Agent Build It](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform/with-an-agent.md): Have a coding agent like Claude Code or Cursor build your headless LearnHouse platform for you, using a ready-made, self-contained specification.
- [Custom Features & Webhooks](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/custom-features.md): Extend LearnHouse beyond the official frontend. Authenticate with API tokens, create and query content programmatically, and react to events with webhooks.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/custom-features/webhooks.md): Subscribe to LearnHouse events, verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures, and react to learning activity in real time with a Next.js webhook receiver.

## Developers

- [LearnHouse Headless](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers.md): Build your own learning platform on LearnHouse — embed lessons, render them in React, or drive everything from the SDK and REST API. Fifty real demos to start from.
- [REST API](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/api.md): The LearnHouse REST API — base URL, authentication, response format, and the full interactive reference.
- [API Authentication](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/api/authentication.md)
- [API Endpoints](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/api/endpoints.md)
- [Headless Assignments](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/api/headless-assignments.md)
- [Architecture Overview](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture.md)
- [Backend Architecture](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture/backend.md)
- [Frontend Architecture](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture/frontend.md)
- [Supporting Services](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture/services.md)
- [Contributing to LearnHouse](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/contributing.md)
- [Development Environment Setup](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/contributing/dev-environment.md)
- [Contribution Guidelines](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/contributing/guidelines.md)
- [Embed](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/embed.md): Put a LearnHouse activity on any website with an iframe, and change its colours and branding with URL parameters.
- [Migrating Content into LearnHouse](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration.md)
- [Activity Types Reference](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/activity-types.md)
- [AI-Assisted Migration](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/assisted.md)
- [Import from Another LMS](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/from-another-lms.md)
- [Programmatic Migration](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/programmatic.md)
- [React Component](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react.md): Render LearnHouse activities inside any React app with @learnhouse/react — the same blocks and styles as LearnHouse, themed to match your product.
- [Customization](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/customization.md): Theme LearnHouseActivity, replace or wrap any block, hide blocks, rewrite content, and add your own header and footer.
- [Events](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/events.md): Listen to what learners do in a LearnHouseActivity — loading, links, media playback, size changes, visibility and completion.
- [Next.js & Vite](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/frameworks.md): Use LearnHouseActivity in the Next.js App Router (including server rendering and fetching on the server) and in Vite apps.
- [How It Works](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/how-it-works.md): How @learnhouse/react renders activities without an editor, and how it is built from LearnHouse's own source at every release.
- [Localization](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/localization.md): Show LearnHouseActivity's interface in 22 languages, override any string, and render right-to-left.
- [Props Reference](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/reference.md): Every prop of LearnHouseActivity and LearnHouseProvider, and everything @learnhouse/react exports.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk.md): @learnhouse/sdk: a typed JavaScript and TypeScript client for the LearnHouse API, with no dependencies. Browsers, Node, Bun, Deno, edge workers and React Native.
- [Authentication](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/authentication.md): Authenticate @learnhouse/sdk with an org API token on servers, or as a signed-in learner in browsers and apps.
- [React Native](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/react-native.md): Use @learnhouse/sdk in React Native and Expo apps — sign learners in, keep their tokens in secure storage, and refresh them.
- [Typed Requests & Errors](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/requests.md): Call any LearnHouse API endpoint with full types, handle errors, and control timeouts, retries, cancellation and request hooks in @learnhouse/sdk.
- [Resources](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/resources.md): The @learnhouse/sdk resources — organizations, courses, chapters, activities, search, progress, users, auth and media URLs — and the endpoint each method calls.
- [Versions & Releases](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/versioning.md): How @learnhouse/sdk, @learnhouse/react and @learnhouse/vue are versioned with LearnHouse releases, and which version to install for your instance.
- [Vue Component](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/vue.md): Render LearnHouse activities in Vue 3 and Nuxt apps with @learnhouse/vue. It wraps the same renderer as @learnhouse/react, so blocks look and behave exactly as they do in LearnHouse.

- [LearnHouse Docs](https://docs.learnhouse.app/index.md): Documentation for LearnHouse, the open-source learning platform. Teach on LearnHouse Cloud, self-host it with one command, or build your own experience on its API, SDK and React components.
